featured.title: Kyiv Hit By Overnight Missile And Drone Attack
featured.content: Russian missile and drone strikes targeted Ukraine's capital overnight, leaving at least one person dead, more than twenty injured and causing fires across several districts. Emergency services remain at affected locations while authorities continue damage assessments.
